name: Directional Adaptive Discrete Wavelet Transform
definition: A transform that performs an exhaustive search over a predefined set of direction vectors to maximize energy compaction into low-pass sub-bands, guaranteeing optimal results in Mean Squared Error (MSE) sense.
summary: Directional Adaptive Discrete Wavelet Transform is a volumetric compression method that exhaustively searches direction vectors to maximize energy compaction, unlike fixed-axis transforms.
